scenes.text: Did you know that the entire world is rapidly running out of one of its most basic resources, and no, it's not fresh water or fossil fuels?

You might look at the vast Sahara Desert and think this is impossible, but desert sand is actually completely useless for construction because wind erodes the grains until they are too smooth to bind together.

To build our massive modern cities, we have to dredge up rough, angular sand from river beds and ocean floors, a process that is destroying marine ecosystems and fueling a dangerous black market run by real-life sand mafias.
The next time you look up at a giant concrete skyscraper, remember it was built using a rapidly vanishing treasure, so comment your thoughts below and follow for more insane stories!
